title: Diamond Gear+
description: Expand your world with this mod! It adds an upgraded "X" tier diamond armor set, a powerful Diamond Sword X, and a brand-new Diamond Shield. Explore the world to find a massive, rare Castle spawning in the Plains, and trade your emeralds with villagers to
body:
Welcome to my mod! Here is everything this mod adds to your world:

⚔️ The "X" Tier Diamond EquipmentUpgrade your arsenal with the ultimate endgame gear! The mod introduces enhanced diamond equipment for elite warriors:

  Diamond Chestplate X – Offers superior protection and durability compared to standard armor.
  
  Diamond Sword X – Deals massive damage to crush your enemies easily.
  
  Diamond Shield – A brand new defensive tool to withstand the toughest battles.

🏰 New Structure: The CastleExplore your world and discover the majestic Castle, a rare new fortress that naturally spawns in the Plains biomes. It is perfectly integrated into the Minecraft landscape and ready for you to conquer!

💼 New Villager TradesInteraction with locals just got better! You can now trade your hard-earned emeralds with villagers to get these powerful "X" tier items directly!
